headline: Ag-Tech Provider Plantium-Gentec Cuts Nearly 100 Jobs in Argentina
summary: Agricultural technology firm Plantium-Gentec has laid off nearly 100 workers and scaled down operations at its Villa Constitucion facility in Santa Fe province.
why: Plantium-Gentec provides high-tech precision tools to Argentina's vital agricultural sector.

impacts.name: Plantium-Gentec
impacts.why: The firm reduced its workforce and operational scale due to financial headwinds.
